statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is medically necessary to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with cardiac conduction abnormalities
The diagnosis codes submitted are I34.0 and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
